subject: Coord: Connectivity & IAM deep-dive — stakeholder scheduling
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coordination: Connectivity & IAM deep-dive

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time on the discovery call last week. To keep momentum, we'd like to schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive that covers VPC/on-prem connectivity, network flows (firewalls/NAT), and IAM role mapping for Redwood’s private deployment options. The primary goals are:

- Surface any network constraints or routing requirements for a VPC peering or VPN setup
- Align on firewall rules/ports and any proxy/NAT considerations
- Map who will own IAM role creation and what IAM policies we need to propose
- Agree on follow-up actions for procurement (NDA/PO/timeline)

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Apr 26: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Fri Apr 29: 14:00–15:30 or 15:30–17:00

Could you confirm who from CloudWare will attend (network engineer, security lead, procurement contact)? I’ve attached a short pre-read (redwood-arch-questions.pdf) with the information we typically need in advance.

If neither of these windows works, please suggest two alternatives and we’ll coordinate with our SE.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right folks in the room.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-arch-questions.pdf

Thanks — appreciate the agenda. I’ll plan to have our network engineer and a member of security on the call. Looping in Eva (security) and our procurement alias.

Our immediate constraints: we have a maintenance window on Apr 26 that makes the morning slot risky. Prefer the Apr 29 slot in the afternoon (14:00–15:30 PT). The other thing: can you share any SOC2 / security artifacts or a short checklist of what you need from us? Procurement will want that before we approve an external-hosted setup.

Attendees I expect to join:
- Liam O'Neill (Platform Eng)

- Eva Morales (Security)
- Procurement (procurement@cloudware.com)

— Liam

Hi all —

Thanks Liam — Apr 29 14:00 PT works for our engineering team as well. I’ll be the SE on the call and will walk through:

1) proposed network topology for a VPC peering and an alternate VPN path
2) expected ports and security groups (we’ll highlight any ephemeral ports for proxying)
3) KV cache sizing and where the control-plane endpoints should be reachable from
4) IAM mapping: service accounts vs. role delegation, and a sample trust policy

Suggested agenda (60–90 min):
- 0–10m: intros + success criteria (AE)
- 10–40m: network topology and firewall implications (SE)
- 40–65m: IAM role mapping + KMS/KV access model (SE)
- 65–80m: procurement/next steps (AE + procurement)

Tentative slots I can block:
- Thu Apr 29 14:00–15:30 PT
- Fri Apr 30 09:00–10:30 PT (alternate)

Zoom link (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=xyz
Pre-reqs: please drop any existing network diagrams or firewall matrices into the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-network-diagrams

I’ve reviewed the attached redwood-arch-questions.pdf and will call out any items we need before the session.

Thanks — Dev
